text:
Alex: Hey folks — cleaning out my desk. Free Ergotron LX dual monitor arm (VESA 75/100) + 34" ultrawide (3440x1440) — works fine, no dead pixels, but no HDMI cable. Also have 2 tickets to a small comedy night in NYC this Thursday (non-transferable name on the ticket, but I can add you). Pickup SF office Thursday AM or I can ship at cost. Pics: https://imgur.com/example :framed_picture:
Marta: interested in the arm — does it support 14-34lb monitors?
Alex: yep, rated 7-34 lbs/monitor. The ultrawide is about 10 lbs so well within range.
Darren: I can swing by Thursday morning. Alex, can you DM me what floor?
Alex: sure — DM sent. I'll hold it for ~2 hours after pickup time, then it's first-come.
Samir: curious about the tickets — what show and what's the name on the reservation? I'm in NYC for work that week maybe.
Alex: small club (Upright Laughs), Thurs 8pm. Name is Alex R. I can update reservation with attendee names if you confirm.
Jess: can I claim the cable? I have an extra DisplayPort but no HDMI. :stuck_out_tongue:
Alex: haha yes please — if you can bring DP cable that'd be perfect.
Darren: also have a VESA adapter if needed, bringing that just in case.
Samir: I can take one ticket if Darren only wants the arm. I'll confirm by 2pm today.
Jess: also — small PSA: please test monitors before taking! We had a mystery flicker last month on a handoff.
Alex: agreed. I'll boot it up Thursday and drop it by the desk with a short test.
OpsBot: Reminder: Office pickup slots close at 6pm, please badge in via front desk.
Marta: noted. Thanks Alex! :thumbsup:
Samir: confirmed — taking 1 ticket. DMing payment for shipping if needed.
Alex: great. For transparency: the stand has minor scuffs, monitor has two tiny scratches on the bottom bezel (not visible in normal use). No warranty. First to pick up + DM for tickets gets them.
Jess: will bring DP cable and a tiny screwdriver.
Darren: see you Thursday 9:15am then.
Alex: thanks y'all — appreciate the quick pickup. If anything changes I'll update this thread.
